title: HLS Media Renditions Runtime
problem: Nako's HLS runtime can execute video variants, but it has no typed media rendition boundary for selected subtitles or alternate audio artifacts.

evidence.summary: Opened the durable fearless refactor lane for a typed HLS media rendition boundary and a first selected-subtitle or alternate-audio foundation slice.
Added typed HLS media rendition and request-variant identity boundaries for selected subtitle sidecar artifacts.
Implemented selected subtitle WebVTT sidecar FFmpeg command planning and HLS artifact allow-listing.
Integrated selected subtitle media renditions into server HLS staging, artifact reconstruction, playlist rewrite coverage, session reuse, and playback route gates.

continue_policy.notes: The lane is closed. Follow-on work should open a new workstream for richer HLS master playlist media tags, full alternate audio, image-subtitle policy, LL-HLS/CMAF/DRM, or a second transcode engine adapter.
